evidence.snippet: Start free, no credit card required.
Only Admin users are able to generate API Keys.

decisions.reason: Copper has no permanent free tier—only paid Basic/Professional/Business plans with a time-limited free trial ('Start free, no credit card required')—and once inside an account an Admin can self-serve generate an API key, matching the self_serve_trial pattern rather than a hard paid-only gate or a fully unknown status.

decisions.reason: A toolkit can be built via self-serve API keys, but real usage requires an Admin role, a trial that converts to a paid seat-based plan, and OAuth app registration needs contacting Copper, so it is buildable with friction rather than fully frictionless.

evidence.snippet: Start free, no credit card required.

decisions.reason: Copper offers only time-limited free trials of paid per-seat plans (no permanent free tier), so sustained API access ultimately depends on purchasing a paid subscription, making paid_plan the dominant blocker over the secondary admin/app-review frictions.
